description: The Visible and Infrared Spin Scan Radiometer (VISSR) on FY-2D is a geostationary scanning radiometer providing visible and multi-channel infrared imagery. Its split-window thermal, middle-infrared, and water vapor channels monitor weather systems, sea surface temperature, and severe convective events.
facility_description: FengYun-2D is a first-generation geostationary meteorological satellite of China, launched in December 2006 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
notes: FY-2D VISSR filter curves originate from the NSMC GSICS portal (http://gsics.nsmc.org.cn/portal/en/fycv/srf.html). Site terms assert Copyright © NSMC(NCSW). All Rights Reserved., and redistribution is subject to CMA data policy. DetectorType is left unchanged.
